purpose: Test whether explicitly requested deterministic algorithms reproduce one original-model training run
changes: Set CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before process launch, torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), cudnn benchmark false and cudnn deterministic true; run two independent same-code one-epoch processes.
validation: Compare all model-state tensors and training order; report unsupported operations or nonidentical states honestly.
limitations: Only one checkpoint and seed, one desktop environment; no guarantee across software versions or hardware. This diagnostic does not rerun the 15-method experiment.
